summary.text: Bobby Harshbarger is a Republican state senator representing Tennessee Senate District 4 (Hawkins and Sullivan Counties), a member of the 114th General Assembly. He is a pharmacist and second vice-chair of the Senate Health and Welfare Committee.

paragraphs.text: Harshbarger was born on January 31, 1985, and earned a bachelor of science degree in biology and chemistry from East Tennessee State University and a Doctor of Pharmacy degree from Mercer University College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences.
He is a former member of the Tennessee Board of Pharmacy and is married to Erin; they have two sons.
In the Senate, Harshbarger also serves on the Energy, Agriculture, and Natural Resources and Judiciary committees.

His listed affiliations include the American College of Apothecaries, the Kingsport Chamber of Commerce and the Kiwanis Club of Kingsport, and he is a former member of the Kingsport Economic Development Board and the Boys & Girls Club of Greater Kingsport board.
